sentences.en: He came to take a walk every morning after rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 1. 康复后，他每天早上都来散步。

sentences.en: Half-hearted cutbacks that can't save money leave JAL's rehabilitation in doubt.
sentences.zh: 2. 半心半意的削减无法节省资金，让日航的复苏前景变得不确定。

sentences.en: Making amends is the first step toward rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 3. 补偿是恢复名誉的第一步。

phrases.zh: 康复中的；康复过程中的

senses.zh: 修复；复兴复职；恢复名誉，昭雪(病残人的)康复，更新；(罪犯的)改过迁善
